scope: scripts/qualify_watch_monitor.py on a frozen Debug build of 01bbf2b3 (artifacts/lm2, git archive), 23/23 steps, on one owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU 1511 instance on Softbus. Fixture: an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 with simulation support whose Main calls "TiaMcp_EnableGate_DB"(Enable := TRUE); the qualification-only watch fixture seed imports MilestoneWatch with two Bool rows, "TiaMcp_EnableGate_DB".Active and .Enable (Host flags --component-qualification --watch-qualification none). After simulation_download, the generated-state save and simulation_provision_scratch_credential, the instance runs. watch_table_monitor (3 samples, 200 ms apart) resolves both rows to the tag-list symbols an independent sim_tags lookup finds (TiaMcp_EnableGate_DB.Active/.Enable, unquoted, DataType Bool) and every sample equals an independent sim_read (TRUE, TRUE), in RUN and again in STOP. Paging (count 1) reports nextOffset 1 then null; the PLC's force table (Force table, 0 rows) is monitored with kind force; watch_table_read afterwards returns the unchanged table hash and rows. Refusals: InvalidRequest (count 0), SimulationOwnershipUnverified (foreign creationId), SimulationTargetMismatch (foreign instance name), WatchTableNotFound (unknown table), SimulationNotSelected (released instance). An earlier attempt (artifacts/q/lm/wm_80d37ed9, frozen 9bcf5dbe) stopped at power-on with SimulationConfigurationPasswordRequired because the runner skipped credential provisioning; no monitor call ran and it is not part of this record.
limitations: One owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU 1511 instance on Softbus; one watch table with two Bool rows of one optimized instance DB, seeded through the qualification-only fixture seed. The force table has no rows, so no force-table value is read.

Both members read TRUE throughout because Main assigns Enable := TRUE every cycle; a value change during monitoring is not exercised. Reads within a sample are sequential PLCSIM API reads, not scan-consistent; the instance's program is not compared with the project.

Absolute-address rows, comment rows, unsupported types, ambiguous or missing symbols and non-Bool types are covered by offline checks only. Nothing is modified or forced: no public force route exists (docs/plans/live-monitoring-forcing-plan.md).
